title: Entropy, area, and the choice of regulator during gravitational collapse
summary: We present a real time formalism to numerically describe the gravitational collapse of a scalar quantum field in the spherically symmetric case. We employ a Pauli-Villars regulator that is specifically designed to cancel the ultraviolet divergences in the energy-momentum tensor identified by covariant point splitting, including the logarithmic ones. Using this regulator, we find that the leading term of the entanglement entropy, which is proportional to the surface area, vanishes for a spherical region of flat spacetime.
